mechanics.claim: A stack of Determination is generated for each enemy champion damaged by Zaahen's basic attacks and abilities, refreshing the fall-off duration.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Determination'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} damaged by his {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers

mechanics.claim: Determination stacks are generated per damage instance per champion damaged, so multi-hit abilities can generate multiple stacks.
mechanics.quote: ''Determination'' stacks are generated per damage instance per champion damaged with '''Zaahen's''' attacks and abilities.

mechanics.claim: The bonus AD from stacks scales dynamically with Zaahen's current total AD.
mechanics.quote: The bonus attack damage granted by ''Determination'' stacks will update dynamically with '''Zaahen's''' total attack damage.

mechanics.claim: At maximum (12) stacks, the per-stack bonus AD doubles.
mechanics.quote: At maximum stacks, '''Zaahen''' becomes filled with ''Determination'', causing him to double the bonus

mechanics.claim: Invulnerability prevents stack generation because no damage is dealt.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Invulnerable|Invulnerability}} will prevent stacks from being generated, as no damage is dealt.

mechanics.claim: During the resurrection, Zaahen is invulnerable, untargetable and unable to act, and his current health is forcibly overridden to match the restoration percentage each tick, preventing other healing from applying.
